{"ascii":"Interactive Canvas Runtime
|-- [M] Modular structure: workspace commands <-> semantic state <-> native rendering
|   |-- Workspace orchestration: MappingWorkspacePage + CanvasWorkspace
|   |   |-- Page coordinates active documents, persistence, transfers, agent commands and chat
|   |   |-- CanvasWorkspace exposes draft handles, controller lookup, change and dirty stores
|   |   `-- Session creation, subscriptions and persistence notifications stay inside the registry
|   |-- Semantic session: CanvasSession -> MappingDocumentController
|   |   |-- Public read surfaces: document, presentation, selection, controls, geometry, status
|   |   |   `-- getState / getInitialState / subscribe; writable backing stores remain private
|   |   |-- Mutations enter through controller commands; mounted and headless sessions share them
|   |   `-- Controller supplies semantic snapshots and checkpoint history [shared S]
|   |-- Native adapter: MappingEditorCanvas + MappingEditorRuntime
|   |   |-- Depends on a session, tldraw Editor and semantic-to-shape projection
|   |   |-- Attaches settle / undo driver to the controller
|   |   `-- Keeps shape reconciliation, checkpoint synchronization and gesture bookkeeping internal
|   `-- Rendering services: CanvasRuntime
|       |-- Exposes per-ID grid, floating-pane, panel and edge models through context
|       |-- CanvasActions callbacks connect rendered controls to application commands
|       `-- Depends on domain layout, local anchors and NativeRoutingStore
|           `-- Routing exposes measurements / sync / drawing; worker queue and caches stay private
|-- [O] State and resource lifetimes
|   |-- CanvasWorkspace owns document sessions
|   |   |-- Draft seed -> new CanvasSession -> new MappingDocumentController [shared S]
|   |   |-- Metadata changes can retain the existing session and update its saved baseline
|   |   |-- Replaced or removed session -> unsubscribe, remove controller lookup, dispose session
|   |   `-- Workspace disposal -> unsubscribe all, clear persistence listeners, dispose sessions
|   |       `-- Session disposal clears cursor-copy state, controller subscription and commit listeners
|   |-- Page retains visited document views across ordinary active-document changes
|   |   `-- Inactive views are hidden; session lifetime is not tied to which canvas is visible
|   |-- Mounted tldraw Editor owns live shape geometry and native undo navigation
|   |   |-- Semantic document and checkpoint archive remain behind the controller [shared S]
|   |   |-- CanvasRuntime owns transient models, anchors, selection bridge and routing service
|   |   `-- Editor cleanup -> complete and settle -> detach listeners and driver
|   |       `-- Clear editor reference -> terminate routing worker and clear outstanding jobs/results
|   `-- Page hosts supporting resources
|       |-- Chat receives the active session and workspace/document target
|       |   `-- Copy-diagram callback stages ASCII in that session's cursorCopy
|       |-- SourcePaneViewState retains camera and pane-view state; cleanup flushes and disposes it
|       `-- Page-created storage is flushed/disposed on cleanup; injected storage stays externally owned
|-- [C] Runtime calls and checkpoint propagation
|   |-- Mount -> MappingEditorRuntime.hydrate()
|   |   |-- Replay historical checkpoint IDs into native history
|   |   `-- Project current shapes; historical geometry is materialized when navigating
|   |-- Native gesture -> shape/selection observer marks runtime dirty
|   |   |-- While pointing, dragging or pinching -> tick does not settle
|   |   `-- Idle tick -> settle()
|   |       |-- Compare native shapes with the last projected shapes
|   |       |-- Grid movement -> rounded, nonnegative grid-position operations
|   |       |-- Supported diagram clones -> duplicate-instance operations
|   |       |   `-- Unsupported native clones are removed
|   |       |-- Floating-pane movement/resize -> display geometry and manual placement policy
|   |       |-- Native selection supplies drag IDs; application gestures own content membership
|   |       `-- Semantic geometry changed -> controller.commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas)
|   |           `-- Controller subscribers publish committed state [shared S]
|   |               |-- CanvasSession updates affected read stores synchronously
|   |               |-- New canvasRevisionId -> onCommit -> workspace change/persist notification
|   |               `-- Native adapter reconciles shapes and records the checkpoint reference
|   |-- Application command -> controller update -> native publish()
|   |   |-- Same checkpoint while pointer is down -> defer projection
|   |   `-- New command checkpoint -> native history stopping point + shape/checkpoint update
|   |-- Undo/redo -> complete gesture -> settle -> native history navigation
|   |   |-- Changed mappingCheckpoint -> restoreEditorCheckpoint(id) -> reproject without recording
|   |   `-- Transfer boundary -> workspace undo/redo coordinates both participating canvases
|   |-- Camera tick -> captureViewCamera + SourcePaneViewState camera callback
|   |   `-- Overlay follows native camera transform; no semantic checkpoint for each camera frame
|   `-- External boundaries
|       |-- WorkspacePersistence connects workspace changes to storage records
|       |   |-- Explicit save -> sync captured document -> storage.flush()
|       |   `-- Version still matches -> publishMappingCheckpoint -> update captured saved baseline
|       |       `-- Later edits are not silently adopted as the saved state
|       |-- Transfer -> prepare histories/transaction -> storage.save() -> install workspace
|       `-- useAgentCanvasBridge registers visible drafts and dispatches handleAgentCommand()
|           |-- Reads -> controller snapshot, identity, nodes or exported revisions
|           |-- Mutations -> controller commands / revision receivers, with method-specific guards
|           `-- Request receipts prevent repeated application; persistence-backed methods flush storage
`-- [D] Computation dependencies: cross-cutting inputs to rendered output
    |-- Projected native shapes = projectMappingShapes([shared S])
    |   |-- Document presentation + diagram views
    |   |   `-- presentationScene -> resolveDiagramView -> flattenGrid -> box hierarchy and bounds
    |   |       `-- Cell dimensions -> pixel positions/sizes, relative to native shape parents
    |   |-- Display nodes + selection + collapse/visibility rules -> floating shapes
    |   |   `-- Collapsed/docked conversations use canvas anchors and bubble geometry
    |   |-- Document edges -> locked arrow shapes
    |   `-- Document alternatives + resolved layout -> locked side-panel shapes
    |-- CanvasRuntime read models also depend on [shared S]
    |   |-- Diagram content, views, cell size, selection and jumps -> per-grid models
    |   |-- Display ancestry + current source content -> pane visibility, stale and missing flags
    |   |-- Semantic edge anchors + resolved diagram layout -> owner-local endpoints
    |   `-- shareEqual preserves equal model branches so unrelated diagrams retain stable values
    |-- Routed edges = native edge inputs + world-space obstacles
    |   |-- Edge definitions + resolved endpoints + native geometry -> nativeEdgeInput()
    |   |-- Obstacles
    |   |   |-- Diagram content + view + cell size -> estimated local rectangles
    |   |   |-- Matching layoutKey measurements override those estimates
    |   |   `-- Local rectangles + editor shape page transforms -> world-space rectangles
    |   |       `-- Camera changes are not routing dependencies
    |   `-- NativeRoutingStore.drawAll()
    |       |-- Dragging -> preview from current inputs and previously settled routes
    |       |-- Matching completed input/obstacle key -> reuse completed routes
    |       |-- New geometry -> one in-flight worker job + newest pending job; preview meanwhile
    |       |   `-- Publish result only if its key is still requested; then dispatch pending job
    |       `-- Worker absent or failed -> synchronous ConnectionRouter fallback
    |           `-- Routing itself performs no DOM reads or document writes
    `-- Dirty status = current semantic state compared with saved baseline
        |-- sceneDirty <- scene state key differs
        `-- isDirty <- scene differs OR edges differ OR name differs
"}
